sloka: स शैलजीमूतनिकाशरूपैर्मांसादनैः पावकदीप्तनेत्रेः ।बभौ वृतो राक्षसराजमुख्यो भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवासुरेशः ।। ६.५९.९ ।।।।
transliteration: sa śailajīmūtanikāśarūpairmāṁsādanaiḥ pāvakadīptanetreḥ ।babhau vṛto rākṣasarājamukhyo bhūtairvṛto rudra ivāsureśaḥ ।। 6.59.9 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa king surrounded by Rakshasas who resembled mountains and clouds in form seemed like Rudra surrounded by asuras.
